original_target.title: Identifying a distribution from its Gaussian-channel MMSE curve

scope_comparison: The cumulant criteria assume a symmetric moment-determinate source and all-order competitor moments; the alternating case requires extra sign restrictions. They neither cover arbitrary finite-variance distributions nor resolve signs from the MMSE curve alone. The institutional October2026 thesis announcement describes three sufficient conditions on symmetric variables, rather than a general resolution.
